title: RvR: Refinement via Regeneration for High-Quality Image Refinement
summary: RvR is a framework that enhances image quality and semantic alignment by regenerating images from high-level semantic tokens rather than pixel-level editing. It utilizes a 7B Mixture-of-Tokens (MoT) model to fix structural errors and stylistic inconsistencies that traditional methods fail to address.
research_notes: Uses ViT-derived semantic tokens to preserve core context while allowing the model to completely redraw structural details.

evolution.summary: Officially released in April 2026 as a collaboration between LeapLabTHU and Tencent Hunyuan. It shifts the paradigm from 'editing' to 'regeneration', showing significant gains on benchmarks like GeneralEval and UniGeneralBench++.
